messages.subject: Epiroc Thailand | Mining technology, responsible operations and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Epiroc Thailand Leadership Team,

Epiroc is one of the strongest strategic fits in Thailand for my background because I work inside the mining environment your technologies serve every day.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy for a major gold-mining operation.

I would bring Epiroc a customer-side understanding of mine operations, regulatory expectations, sustainability pressures and the stakeholder conditions that shape technology adoption. My recent work also includes large-scale solar and battery-storage transition support and carbon-data governance.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional mandates across Country Strategy, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or senior mining stakeholder leadership. I have attached an Epiroc Thailand-focused executive CV.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
